findings.title: guard accepts a ledger outside the immutable release
findings.evidence: guarded_unlock reads ledger.path but never requires ledger.path.resolve() == release_root/runs/experiment-ledger.jsonl. A temporary external matching ledger was accepted and target numbers were read (number_read_count=1).
findings.required_remediation: bind the guard to the exact release ledger path and exact ledger/run identity before any label read; add a rejection test asserting number_read_count remains zero.

findings.title: trainer label-store denial is a forgeable role assertion, not a capability boundary
findings.evidence: GuardedLabelStore and read_scoring_label_inventory authorize caller_role == 'scorer'. The spawn worker inherits cwd/filesystem and imports formal.py/data_access.py, so a trainer-side process can self-assert the scorer string. Existing trainer_access controls only submit the honest string 'trainer'.
findings.required_remediation: replace role-string authorization with a scorer-only capability unavailable to the trainer process and/or launch the trainer under an enforceable filesystem boundary; ensure the negative control attempts the real unauthorized access path rather than an honest role declaration.

findings.title: bottom-up guarded-unlock recomputation does not verify the global latest lock state
findings.evidence: validate_guarded_unlock_evidence and independent_model_reconstruction group events per attempt and accept the local sequence started/forecast_locked/label_unlocked/scored/succeeded. They do not assert that the globally immediately preceding event for each label_unlocked is that same attempt's forecast_locked, although the runtime guard and frozen design require the global latest event to be the matching lock.
findings.required_remediation: recompute global predecessor/latest state from ledger order for every receipt and add an interleaving mutation negative test.

findings.title: bottom-up recomputation omits lock path and lock run identity bindings
findings.evidence: both recomputers compare the lock forecast SHA but not lock.details.forecast_path to the indexed/current forecast path, and do not require lock.ledger_identity to equal the receipt/forecast run_id. Therefore their 600/600 result cannot independently establish every runtime guard predicate.
findings.required_remediation: bind lock path, current SHA, release/run/experiment/attempt/target/model, receipt, metric and store identity in both primary and independent recomputation; add mutations for lock path, global interleaving and lock run identity.

findings.title: training data flow no longer directly loads the full draw inventory
findings.evidence: run_formal uses label-free load_target_catalog, bounded read_training_prefix and a spawn payload. The worker receives prior-number fields only and checks every issue is strictly earlier than target; read_draws remains limited to non-W08 preparation diagnostics.

findings.title: listed negative controls reject before the instrumented target-number read
findings.evidence: pre-lock, wrong hash, rewritten forecast, wrong release/experiment/attempt/target and honest trainer-role cases all passed and retained number_read_count == 0.
